read_excel_spreadsheet: read an Excel spreadsheet file into a Polars DataFrame using the calamine engine
read_ods_spreadsheet: read an OpenOffice ODS spreadsheet file into a Polars DataFrame
read_multiple_excel_sheets: read multiple sheets from an Excel workbook and return a dict mapping sheet names to DataFrames
read_excel_with_schema_overrides: read an Excel file with custom column type overrides and schema inference length
read_excel_from_multiple_files: read data from multiple Excel workbooks using glob patterns and concatenate results
